heading_en: Applying Mutatis Mutandis the Top-Down Approach, etc. in Calculating K_{IRB}
summary_ja: K_{IRB}の算出で、原資産プールの個別債務者のデフォルト・リスクを評価困難な場合に、購入債権に係るトップ・ダウン・アプローチ等の規定を読み替えて準用できる要件等を定める。
summary_en: Permits, subject to conditions, the purchased-receivables top-down provisions (Articles 145, 147-148, 206-210) to be applied with the prescribed substitutions to an original asset pool when calculating K_{IRB}.
paragraphs: Where, in calculating the total required capital amount of the underlying assets for the purpose of calculating K_{IRB} in paragraph (1) of the preceding Article and K_{IRB} in the formula set out in paragraph (8) of that Article, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach finds that the portion of the exposures of the underlying assets that constitutes an original asset pool is composed of corporate, etc. exposures having all of the following properties, and it is difficult for that Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach to assess the default risk of the obligors of the individual corporate, etc. exposures included in that original asset pool, and it satisfies all of the requirements prescribed in the provisions applied mutatis mutandis under paragraph (3) and all other relevant minimum requirements of the internal ratings-based approach, it may use the PD, LGD, EAD and effective maturity of that original asset pool obtained by applying mutatis mutandis Article 145 and Article 147, paragraphs (2) through (9). In this case, in these provisions, the phrases "pool of purchased receivables," "pool of eligible purchased corporate, etc. exposures" and "eligible purchased corporate, etc. exposure pool" shall be deemed to be replaced with "original asset pool"; the phrase ", of eligible purchased corporate, etc. exposures" with ", of the corporate, etc. exposures of the original asset pool"; the phrase ", such eligible purchased corporate, etc. exposures" with ", the corporate, etc. exposures of that original asset pool"; in paragraph (3) of that Article, the phrase "pool of exposures" with "original asset pool"; in paragraph (6) of that Article, the phrase "purchased corporate, etc. exposures" with "purchased corporate, etc. exposures included in the original asset pool", the phrase "this Section" with "this paragraph" and the term "EL_{dilution}" with "EL_{dilution} of the exposures constituting the original assets"; in paragraphs (7) and (9) of that Article, the phrase "credit facility relating to revolving purchased receivables" with "credit facility relating to revolving purchased receivables provided by a securitization special purpose entity in an asset-transfer securitization transaction"; in paragraph (8) of that Article, the phrase "eligible purchased corporate, etc. exposures using the top-down approach" with "corporate, etc. exposures of the original asset pool by applying mutatis mutandis the top-down approach" and the phrase "for each eligible purchased corporate, etc. exposure" with "for each corporate, etc. exposure"; and in paragraph (9) of that Article, the phrase "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach" with "that securitization special purpose entity" and the phrase "the maturity of that eligible purchased corporate, etc. exposure prescribed in the preceding paragraph" with "the effective maturity (M*) calculated under the provisions of the preceding paragraph". (i) The originator (excluding a person falling under Article 1, item (lxviii)(b); the same applies in the next item) is an independent third party from the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach that holds the securitization exposure, and is not a person to whom that Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach has extended credit directly or indirectly. (ii) The obligors of the original assets are independent third parties from the originator. (iii) The Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach that holds the securitization exposure has a right to the whole of the principal and interest payments from the original asset pool allocated to the securitization exposure it holds in accordance with the contractual terms of the securitization transaction. (iv) The original asset pool is highly diversified.

Where, in calculating the total required capital amount of the underlying assets for the purpose of calculating K_{IRB} in paragraph (1) of the preceding Article and K_{IRB} in the formula set out in paragraph (8) of that Article, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach finds that the portion of the exposures of the underlying assets that constitutes an original asset pool is composed of retail exposures, and that Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach cannot use internal data as the primary source of information in assessing the default risk of that original asset pool, and it satisfies all of the requirements prescribed in the provisions applied mutatis mutandis under the next paragraph and all other relevant minimum requirements of the internal ratings-based approach relating to retail exposures, it may use the PD, LGD and EAD of that original asset pool obtained by applying mutatis mutandis Article 145 and Article 148. In this case, in these provisions, the phrases "pool of purchased receivables" and "pool of purchased retail exposures" shall be deemed to be replaced with "original asset pool"; in paragraph (1) of that Article, the phrase "purchased retail exposures" with "retail exposures of the original asset pool"; in paragraph (2) of that Article, the phrase "purchased retail exposures" with "purchased retail exposures included in the original asset pool", the phrase "this Section" with "this paragraph" and the term "EL_{dilution}" with "EL_{dilution} of the exposures constituting the original assets"; and in paragraph (3) of that Article, the phrase "that pool" with "that original asset pool".

The provisions of Articles 206 through 210 apply mutatis mutandis to the cases in the preceding two paragraphs. In this case, in these provisions (excluding Article 207, paragraph (1) and Article 210, paragraph (4), item (v)), the phrase "seller of the purchased receivables" shall be deemed to be replaced with "originator"; in Article 206, the phrase "purchased retail exposures and eligible purchased corporate, etc. exposures to which the top-down approach is applied, among purchased receivables" with "retail exposures and corporate, etc. exposures constituting the original asset pool"; in Article 207, paragraphs (1) and (4), the term "EL_{dilution}" with "EL_{dilution} of the exposures constituting the original asset pool"; in paragraph (1) of that Article, the phrase "where the seller of the purchased receivables guarantees the purchased receivables" with "where the originator (excluding a person falling under Article 1, item (lxviii)(b); hereinafter the same applies in this Division) guarantees the exposures constituting the original asset pool"; in paragraph (2) of that Article, the phrase "for eligible purchased corporate, etc. exposures" with "for corporate, etc. exposures constituting the original asset pool", the phrase "or where it estimates EL_{dilution}" with "or where it estimates EL_{dilution} of the corporate, etc. exposures constituting the original asset pool", the phrase "for purchased retail exposures" with "for retail exposures constituting the original asset pool", the phrase "LGD or EL_{dilution}" with "LGD or EL_{dilution} of the retail exposures constituting the original asset pool" and the phrase "the pool to which the eligible purchased corporate, etc. exposures or purchased retail exposures belong" with "the pool to which those exposures belong"; in that paragraph and in Article 210, paragraphs (1), (4) and (6), the phrase "quality of the purchased receivables" with "quality of the original assets"; in Article 207, paragraph (3), the phrase "the contract for transfer of the purchased receivables" with "the contract relating to the securitization transaction", the phrase "the type and amount of the purchased receivables and the quality of the receivables during the contract period" with "the type and amount of the exposures constituting the original asset pool and the quality of those exposures during the contract period" and the phrase "relating to the purchased receivables" with "relating to that original asset pool"; in Article 208, paragraph (1) and Article 209, the phrase "purchased retail exposures and eligible purchased corporate, etc. exposures to which the top-down approach is applied" with "exposures constituting the original asset pool"; in Article 208, paragraph (1), the phrase "with respect to eligible purchased corporate, etc. exposures to which the top-down approach is applied" with "with respect to corporate, etc. exposures constituting the original asset pool"; in paragraph (2) of that Article, the phrase "eligible purchased corporate, etc. exposures" with "exposures constituting the original asset pool" and the term "seller" with "originator"; in paragraph (3) of that Article, the phrase "eligible purchased corporate, etc. exposures" with "corporate, etc. exposures constituting the original asset pool"; in Article 210, the phrase "purchased retail exposures" with "retail exposures constituting the original asset pool", the phrase "obligors of the purchased receivables" with "obligors of the original assets" and the phrase "from the creditor of the purchased receivables to the obligor" with "from the creditor of the original assets to the obligor"; in paragraph (1) of that Article, the phrase "purchased corporate, etc. exposures" with "corporate, etc. exposures constituting the original asset pool", the phrase "management of the purchased receivables" with "management of the original asset pool", the phrase "claim for the purchased receivables" with "claim for the receivables" and the phrase "purchase of the purchased receivables" with "securitization transaction"; in paragraph (3) of that Article, the phrase "principal and interest payments, etc. of the purchased receivables" with "principal and interest payments, etc. of the original asset pool allocated to the securitization exposure it holds", the phrase "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach that is the transferee" with "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach or securitization special purpose entity that holds the securitization exposure", the phrase "the purchased receivables are" with "the original asset pool is", the phrase "to the purchased receivables" with "to the original asset pool", the phrase "the transferee's" with "that of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach that holds the securitization exposure" and the phrase "transfer of the purchased receivables" with "securitization transaction relating to that original asset pool"; in paragraph (4) of that Article, the phrase "credit extended to obligors" with "credit extended to obligors of the original assets", the phrase "pool of purchased receivables" with "original asset pool", the phrase "deferral of obligations under purchased receivables and dilution of those receivables" with "deferral of obligations and dilution relating to the exposures constituting the original asset pool", the phrase "on the purchased receivables" with "on the original asset pool" and the phrase "the seller's conditions of sale of the purchased receivables" with "the conditions under which the originator provides the original assets of the securitization transaction"; in paragraph (5) of that Article, the phrase "purchase of the purchased receivables" with "securitization transaction", the phrase "eligibility of the purchased receivables" with "eligibility of the original assets", the phrase "for the purchased receivables" with "for the original assets" and the phrase "pool of purchased receivables" with "original asset pool"; in paragraph (6) of that Article, the phrase "purchase of receivables" with "securitization transaction"; and in paragraph (7) of that Article, the phrase "purchase of the purchased receivables" with "purchase of the original assets by a securitization special purpose entity".

Where, in satisfying the requirements prescribed in Article 210, paragraphs (3) through (7) (excluding item (iii) of paragraph (5)) as applied mutatis mutandis with the replacements under the preceding paragraph, the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach that holds the securitization exposure cannot satisfy them itself, this does not preclude a party to the securitization transaction who acts, in accordance with the contractual terms of the securitization transaction, for the benefit of the investors in the securitization transaction from satisfying those requirements in place of that Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach.
